messages:
Jake (Sales): Quick handoff for Orion Spark — closed E2E today, needs CS+Eng handoff
Maria (CS): thanks! quick summary?
Jake (Sales): Account: Orion Spark (healthtech), expected users 2-3M/month, initial scope: chat triage + embeddings for clinical docs. Signed: private deployment + SSO + data residency EU.
Maria (CS): noted. Key risk: they want guaranteed 99.9% latency under 250ms for conversational path. Also want audit logs and KMS. Renewal in 11 months. Budget sensitive, high chance to downgrade if costs spike.
Sam (Success Manager): Owners: Maria = primary CS lead; Olivia = eng contact for private deploy; Kai = support escalation. Jake please attach contract + SSO IdP metadata.
Jake (Sales): attaching link to internal deal doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ORION-CTRL (internal). IdP metadata sent to customer, they use Azure AD with SCIM.
Olivia (Eng): ping — what infra footprint? GPUs? expected concurrency?
Jake (Sales): initial commit 4xA100 equivalent baseline, can scale to 8 for burst. Latency SLO applies to 99p tokens on chat. Model: open-variant fine-tuned — want option to fall back to a smaller quantized model.
Olivia (Eng): ok. I’ll start private deploy ticket. Need SSO cert + network CIDR, certs for KMS. Sam — can you run a quick test plan for latency + correctness?
Sam (Success Manager): will do. Proposed 3-phase onboarding: 1) Provision & networking (two-week window), 2) Enablement + integration (2 weeks), 3) Canary + performance tuning (1 week). Target go-live: 2025-02-10. Thoughts?
Maria (CS): timeline looks tight but doable. I'll book enablement sessions and send integration checklist.
Kai (Support): will create a dedicated Slack channel and a support runbook. Also will request priority escalation path and on-call rotation during canary.
Olivia (Eng): created internal ticket DP-12345 for private deploy. draft config:
```
cluster: private-vpc-eu
gpu_pool: 4xA100
model_pin: orion-v1.0
fallback_model: orion-lite-v0.9-8bit
slo_latency_ms: 250
audit: enabled
kms: customer-kms-eu
```
Olivia (Eng): need VPN endpoint & firewall rules from customer.
Maria (CS): @Jake can you confirm they'll provision the firewall rules? Also capture API keys rotation policy.
Jake (Sales): yes customer agreed to open 3 specific CIDRs and provide a service account for KMS. I'll add to the deal doc.
deploy-bot: Private deploy ticket DP-12345 created and assigned to eng-team-infra.
Sam (Success Manager): next actions: Maria to schedule 3 onboarding calls, Olivia to confirm infra cost estimate by EOD Friday, Kai to create runbook + Slack, Jake to upload contract + IdP metadata.
Maria (CS): I’ll send calendar invites and the integration checklist by EOD.
Olivia (Eng): cost estimate posted: https://internal.redwood/costs/DP-12345 (internal). Rough monthly: $38k committed, $5k buffer.
Kai (Support): runbook draft in #orion-spark-support. I'll invite people after invite link.
Jake (Sales): flagged renewal note: include preferred discount tier at 9 months if uptake strong — Sam please monitor usage 60/90 day.
Sam (Success Manager): noted. I’ll set a renewal checkpoint at month 8 and quarterly health metrics: latency, error rate, token spend, active users.
Maria (CS): thanks team. if anything blocks, escalate in thread. :thumbsup:
Olivia (Eng): will update DP-12345 with network checklist and add canary playbook.
Kai (Support): added initial runbook link. Counting on eng to populate alert thresholds.
Jake (Sales): thanks all — welcome Orion Spark onboard! :party:
Maria (CS): closing handoff — will post weekly status until go-live.
